sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Where you find the departed, you'll find the Memorial Mob.
Whether it be along a recent battlefield, an abandoned dungeon...
The Memorial Mob will make an appearance.
If you seek them out, they'll surely present their wares.

sections.heading: Location
sections.text: - Abandoned Dungeon Entrace: located just a few feet away from the Sculptor's Idol.

sections.heading: Fountainhead Palace (Fountainhead Palace)
sections.text: Upon defeating the Corrupted Monk, the Dragon's Tally Board she drops will unlock new items at every merchant.

sections.heading: Ashina Outskirts ( Outskirts Wall - Stairway )
sections.text: Complete Anayama's questline (see his page for in depth info) to acquire the Promissory Note, which will discount by 10% the cost of every item sold by merchants.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text:
First Encounter with a Mob | Memorial Mob: Care to purchase an offering?
Wolf: An offering?
Memorial Mob: Indeed. I sell items to be offered to the dead, so they might rest in peace. From the looks of you, I'd wager you have a lot of blood on your hands. ...go ahead, buy an offering.
First Encounter | Memorial Mob: Care to purchase an offering?
Wolf: Another one...
Memorial Mob: Where you find the departed, you'll find the Memorial Mob... We, the impure, cannot turn a blind eye to anyone. ...go ahead, buy an offering.
Leaving | Memorial Mob: Where you find the departed, you'll find the Memorial Mob... Wherever your travels take you, make sure you bring some offerings.
Greeting (Generic) | Memorial Mob: Care to purchase an offering?
Leaving (Generic) | Memorial Mob: May the departed rest in peace...
Talking after Jinzaemon has been sent to Doujun | Memorial Mob: ... You're no stranger to cruelty, I see. You've brought such an earnest samurai to a place such as this... While we don't concern ourselves with the living, I must say, some day, this will come back to haunt you.
Talking after Kotaro has been sent to Doujun | Memorial Mob: ... You're no stranger to cruelty, I see. To bring a naïve, kindhearted man to a place such as this... While we don't concern ourselves with the living, I must say, some day, this will come back to haunt you.
When Infected with Dragonrot | Memorial Mob: I've been... Cursed... (Wheeze... Wheeze...) It's this place... so much brutality... I must... make an offering...

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Purchasing the Prayer Bead from the Dungeon Memorial Mob is a necessary step to unlock the "Peak Physical Strength" trophy.
- Sells one of the three pieces of the Dancing Dragon Mask, the other two fragments being sold by Pot Noble Harunaga and Pot Noble Koremori.
